content.text: Implemented the fix in `src/dotenv/parser.py` only. `parse_unquoted_value` now returns `""` when the captured value part starts with `#` (the case where `_equal_sign` already consumed the whitespace after `=`, e.g. `KEY= # explanation`). The existing `\s+#.*` strip still handles trailing inline comments like `KEY=a # comment`, and `KEY=#literal` / `KEY=a#b` remain literal. Quoting, exports, and ordinary comments are unaffected. No tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies were modified.
